Summary: AG Sprint 4 — Production Hardening, Deployment, and Final Submission
Description: Stabilize, secure, deploy, document, and present AgentGuard as a complete MSSE Capstone deliverable.

Summary: Replace demonstration access with production-ready authentication
Description: Harden identity, sessions, authorization, and environment configuration for the deployed system.
Acceptance Criteria: The deployed application uses secure authentication, role-based authorization, protected secrets, and environment-specific configuration without demo tokens.

Summary: Implement secure login and token lifecycle
Description: Add password hashing or external identity integration, short-lived access tokens, and safe logout behavior.

Summary: Complete RBAC and object-level authorization review
Description: Verify every endpoint and UI action against organization, role, ownership, and approval permissions.

Summary: Harden production CORS, cookies, headers, and secrets
Description: Apply least-privilege origins, secure headers, secret management, and production-safe settings.

Summary: Complete full automated regression coverage
Description: Create a balanced unit, integration, frontend, end-to-end, security, and AI evaluation test suite.
Acceptance Criteria: All critical user stories have automated coverage, the complete suite runs in CI, and no critical regression remains.

Summary: Add frontend component and interaction tests
Description: Test policy forms, approval actions, audit filters, validation, and error states.

Summary: Add Playwright end-to-end governance journeys
Description: Automate login, policy setup, allow, deny, approval, MCP execution, and audit verification.

Summary: Publish coverage and test evidence
Description: Generate coverage summaries and document test scope, rationale, limitations, and results.

Summary: Complete security and privacy hardening
Description: Address the final threat model and verify protection against common web, API, agent, and integration risks.
Acceptance Criteria: Authorization, injection, dependency, secret, rate-limit, privacy, and agent-bypass checks pass with no unresolved critical findings.

Summary: Run authorization, IDOR, and input-security tests
Description: Test cross-organization access, privilege escalation, malformed inputs, and unsafe object references.

Summary: Add rate limiting and abuse protections
Description: Protect authentication, decision, explanation, approval, and execution endpoints from excessive use.

Summary: Run dependency, secret, and static security scanning
Description: Configure CI checks and resolve or document material findings.

Summary: Improve performance, resilience, and recoverability
Description: Measure and improve critical paths and document operational recovery for the deployed system.
Acceptance Criteria: Critical API paths meet documented targets, failures are handled safely, and backup, restore, health, and rollback procedures are verified.

Summary: Add performance smoke and concurrency tests
Description: Measure policy evaluation, audit queries, approval processing, and MCP execution under representative load.

Summary: Review PostgreSQL indexes and query plans
Description: Optimize decision, approval, policy-version, correlation, and audit-history queries.

Summary: Document backup, restore, rollback, and outage behavior
Description: Verify migration rollback strategy, database backup/restore, degraded AI behavior, and MCP outage handling.

Summary: Polish accessibility and user experience
Description: Make the final demonstration clear, responsive, accessible, and resilient to user errors.
Acceptance Criteria: Critical workflows are keyboard accessible, responsive, clearly labeled, and provide useful loading, success, empty, and error states.

Summary: Complete keyboard, labels, focus, and contrast review
Description: Fix accessibility issues in forms, tables, dialogs, navigation, and status messaging.

Summary: Polish responsive layouts and data presentation
Description: Improve mobile and desktop layouts, long values, audit tables, timelines, and dashboards.

Summary: Add stable demo data and guided empty/error states
Description: Ensure the production demo starts predictably and clearly explains missing data or failures.

Summary: Deploy the complete production system
Description: Deploy the React frontend, FastAPI backend, PostgreSQL database, and required integrations to an accessible production environment.
Acceptance Criteria: The public deployment uses HTTPS, applies migrations safely, passes smoke tests, and is linked from the repository.

Summary: Provision production frontend, API, and PostgreSQL
Description: Create the selected hosting services, domains, environment variables, and database connection.

Summary: Automate production deployment and migrations
Description: Deploy from the approved branch with gated CI, migration execution, health checks, and rollback notes.

Summary: Run production smoke and integration verification
Description: Verify authentication, policies, decisions, approvals, MCP test tools, audit export, and AI fallback in production.

Summary: Finalize architecture, design, testing, and cost documentation
Description: Create the detailed design and testing evidence required for the Capstone submission.
Acceptance Criteria: The final document explains architecture and patterns, technology choices, testing methods/results, deployment alternatives, and relative cost implications.

Summary: Finalize architecture diagrams and ADRs
Description: Document components, data flow, trust boundaries, adapters, patterns, and major decisions with rationale.

Summary: Finalize test strategy, results, and traceability matrix
Description: Map user stories to tests and include automated/manual evidence, limitations, and defect outcomes.

Summary: Document deployment options and relative costs
Description: Compare the chosen cloud deployment with alternatives such as on-premises and summarize expected cost tradeoffs.

Summary: Complete agile, repository, and release evidence
Description: Ensure the repository and Jira board clearly prove the project journey, delivered stories, CI/CD, testing, and release management.
Acceptance Criteria: All agreed stories and tasks have accurate Jira status and evidence, the README links every required artifact, and the final release is tagged.

Summary: Complete Jira statuses, evidence, and sprint retrospectives
Description: Attach PRs, commits, screenshots, test results, demos, planning notes, and retrospectives to the appropriate stories.

Summary: Finalize README and required accessible links
Description: Add deployed app, Jira board, design/testing document, demo video, installation, attribution, and limitations.

Summary: Create final changelog and v1.0.0 release
Description: Freeze scope, resolve release blockers, publish release notes, and tag the submission-ready commit.

Summary: Record and submit the final Capstone demonstration
Description: Prepare and submit a professional 15–20 minute recording that demonstrates the deployed AgentGuard system and required evidence.
Acceptance Criteria: The recording demonstrates a range of working user stories, remains within 15–20 minutes, shows the presenter and ID as required, and all submission links are accessible.

Summary: Write and rehearse the final demonstration script
Description: Time the introduction, architecture, allow/deny/approval/MCP workflows, audit evidence, testing, CI/CD, limitations, and conclusion.

Summary: Record and quality-check the final video
Description: Capture clear screen sharing, visible and audible presentation, government-issued ID, and a stable deployed workflow.

Summary: Verify permissions and submit all required links
Description: Confirm repository access for quantic-grader, Jira visibility, production availability, Google Drive permissions, and dashboard submission.
